interpretation.c2_raw_improves: if c2_raw materially lowers curvature with tiny delta-U, derivative representation/C1 knot jumps contribute
interpretation.candidate_warning: candidate priors are unvalidated and must not replace production priors before matched NVT structure and NVE scaling tests
interpretation.interior_hotspots: large occupied interior curvature implicates the IBI body/update smoothing rather than only the wall
interpretation.wall_hotspots: large curvature localized in the wall zone implicates the artificial endpoint barrier
interpretation.wider_same_barrier_improves: if a wider same-barrier wall lowers curvature but affects little target probability, wall redesign is plausible
